OgGslcWPCqvWEfx9ZxfYWw.en: Situation update: global test positivity dipped slightly to 3.37% in week 1 of this year (29 December–4 January), but rose notably in the Western Pacific and African Regions. q8g_sRQ9Mqx9xC1F0EcNzw.en: China reported 3 new H9N2 cases, all mild, with onset between 30 November and 7 December 2025. Case 1: a 5-year-old boy in Hubei province with poultry contact. 0sxS5AJ4O4cWa_iS_65WOw.zh: 韓國疫情自2025年11月起持續攀升,今年迄第2週止已新增548例病例,為近5年同期最高,其中6歲以下病患占約4成;該國疫情好發於11-3月,主要感染源為受汙染的地下水或海鮮,亦可能透過接觸病患的飛沫或嘔吐物感染,當局呼籲注意個人衛生,尤其托兒機構等應加強衛生防護措施。 中國廣東省佛山市1/17報告某高中群聚事件,累計103例病例,迄無重症或死亡病例,當局已展開調查,加強衛生教育與清消;另中國有78-93%的諾羅疫情發生於校園,疫情流行於10-3月。 日本岩手縣1/20報告1起托嬰中心群聚事件,累計22例病例,包括21名幼童及1名工作人員,其中有4例檢驗呈陽性,發病日介於1/7-18。
0sxS5AJ4O4cWa_iS_65WOw.en: South Korea's situation has risen continuously since November 2025, with 548 new cases reported through week 2 of this year, the highest for the same period in the past five years. About 40% of patients were under 6 years old. Outbreaks typically occur from November to March, mainly from contaminated groundwater or seafood, and infection can also occur through respiratory droplets or contact with patients' vomit. Authorities urge attention to personal hygiene, and childcare facilities in particular should strengthen hygiene and protection measures. On 17 January, Foshan City in Guangdong Province, China, reported a cluster at a senior high school, with 103 cumulative cases; no severe or fatal cases have been recorded. Authorities have launched an investigation and are strengthening health education and disinfection. In China, 78–93% of norovirus outbreaks occur in schools, and outbreaks are prevalent from October to March. On 20 January, Iwate Prefecture in Japan reported a cluster at a nursery centre, with 22 cumulative cases, including 21 young children and 1 staff member; 4 tested positive, with onset dates between 7 and 18 January.

8SI8aEZnrjlg0mxf6I-uqQ.zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:中國新增3例H9N2流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共23國於2025/12/22-2026/1/16期間新增116起H5N1疫情,美國49起、波蘭/荷蘭7起、加拿大/奧地利/比利時各6起、法國5起、丹麥/德國各4起、匈牙利/斯洛維亞/瑞士各3起、愛沙亞/日本各2起、伊拉克/拉脫維亞/挪威/捷克/摩爾多瓦/烏克蘭/義大利/臺灣/西班牙各1起。 共2國於2026/1/13-2026/1/14期間新增2起H5N2疫情,拉脫維亞/瑞典各1起。 美國於2026/1/10期間新增7起H5 (N untyped) 疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:2024年3月迄今累計19州報告1,084起疫情,近期主要集中於威斯康辛州。 具乳牛接觸史者:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測至少218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:2026/1/4-10共549個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中紐澤西/伊利諾/奧勒岡州共8個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H9N2流感3例(迄今累計168例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。 禽類/動物案例:今年累計22國家/地區通報69起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
8SI8aEZnrjlg0mxf6I-uqQ.en: Weekly summary. Human cases: China reported 3 new human H9N2 infections. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of 23 countries reported 116 new H5N1 outbreaks between 22 December 2025 and 16 January 2026: United States 49; Poland and Netherlands 7 each; Canada, Austria and Belgium 6 each; France 5; Denmark and Germany 4 each; Hungary, Slovenia and Switzerland 3 each; Estonia and Japan 2 each; and Iraq, Latvia, Norway, Czechia, Moldova, Ukraine, Italy, Taiwan and Spain 1 each. Two countries reported 2 new H5N2 outbreaks between 13 and 14 January 2026: Latvia and Sweden 1 each. The United States reported 7 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks during 10 January 2026. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: herds: 1,084 outbreaks have been reported across 19 states since March 2024, with recent activity concentrated in Wisconsin. Persons with dairy cattle exposure: at least 9,600 monitored cumulatively and at least 218 tested, of whom 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: for 4–10 January 2026, 549 sampling sites reported results, of which 8 sites in New Jersey, Illinois and Oregon detected H5 positives. Annual summary: human cases: this year, 3 H9N2 cases have been reported (168 cumulative), most with exposure to susceptible animals before onset. Animal and avian cases: this year, 22 countries and areas have reported 69 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: the FAO/WHO/WOAH risk assessment of H5 viruses dated 28 July finds that H5 viruses (including clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly been associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no capacity for human-to-human transmission. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the general public remains at low risk, and people who often handle contaminated animals or environments are at low to moderate risk, depending mainly on the type and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurised dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response.

rgEoN1mnvc0qw6SPioZtlQ.en: Situation update: global test positivity rose slightly to 3.51% in week 52 of 2025 (22–28 December), with notable increases in the Americas, African and European Regions. RTR5UFvttLLtdIdG-J05ag.en: In China's respiratory sample testing for the past week (29 December 2025–4 January 2026), the top three pathogens among sentinel hospital outpatient and emergency influenza-like illness cases were influenza virus (27.4%), RSV (8.8%) and rhinovirus (5.7%). Recent rhinovirus test positivity has fluctuated within a range, with differences between northern and southern regions and across age groups. In southern provinces, rhinovirus was the second most common pathogen; among those aged 15–59 and 60 and over, rhinovirus was also the second most common pathogen.

ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.zh: 全球疫情更新,2025年截至12/10共41國/地區累計報告502,264例病例(208,335例確診)及186例死亡,WHO表示季節期間多個區域爆發廣泛疫情,包括先前傳播率較低或無傳播之地區,評估全球傳播風險為中。各區署疫情如下:  美洲區病例為多,該區共16國累計報告291,451例病例(110,039例確診)及141例死亡,以巴西報告243,915例病例及116例死亡為多;  東南亞區累計報告115,985例病例(7,097例確診),主要分布於印度及泰國,其中印度截至8/31累計報告108,379例疑病例及4,995例確診病例; 歐洲區累計56,986例確診病例及43例死亡,其中法國及義大利報告本土病例,另法屬留旺島累計54,555例確診病例及43例死亡,法屬馬約特島累計報告1,259例本土病例; 西太平洋區共11國/地區累計34,035例確診病例及2例死亡,其中中國累計29,497例本土確診病例,主要分布於該國廣東省25,826例; 非洲區累計報告2,211例病例(111例確診),以模里西斯共和國報告1,583例病例為多,葛摩、肯亞、塞內加爾亦報告病例; 東地中海區累計報告1,596例病例(67例確診),其中巴基斯坦及索馬利亞報告病例。
ey-aEDjotSBWGWAVyB_WNg.en: Global outbreak update: in 2025, as of 10 December, 41 countries and areas had reported 502,264 cases cumulatively (208,335 confirmed) and 186 deaths. WHO said widespread outbreaks occurred during the season in several regions, including areas where transmission had previously been low or absent, and assessed the global transmission risk as moderate. Regional situation: the Region of the Americas reported the most cases. Sixteen countries reported 291,451 cases cumulatively (110,039 confirmed) and 141 deaths, mainly Brazil with 243,915 cases and 116 deaths. The South-East Asia Region reported 115,985 cases cumulatively (7,097 confirmed), mainly in India and Thailand; India reported 108,379 suspected and 4,995 confirmed cases as of 31 August. The European Region reported 56,986 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively. France and Italy reported local cases. Separately, French Réunion reported 54,555 confirmed cases and 43 deaths cumulatively, and French Mayotte reported 1,259 local cases cumulatively. The Western Pacific Region reported 34,035 confirmed cases and 2 deaths cumulatively across 11 countries and areas; China reported 29,497 local confirmed cases, mainly 25,826 in Guangdong province. The African Region reported 2,211 cases cumulatively (111 confirmed), mainly 1,583 cases in the Republic of Mauritius; the Comoros, Kenya and Senegal also reported cases. The Eastern Mediterranean Region reported 1,596 cases cumulatively (67 confirmed), with Pakistan and Somalia reporting cases.

R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/30累計142國/地區報告17萬5千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%);今年截至11/30累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中206例死亡(CFR:0.41%)。 今年11月共計48國家/地區報告2,150 例新增確診病例,其中 5例死亡(CFR:0.27%),68%來自非洲地區,相較10月,歐洲區與西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。 非洲地區近6週(11/2–12/14)共計19 國通報1,435例確診病例,其中7 例死亡(CFR:0.5%),其中以剛果民主共和國(427例)、幾內亞(330例)、賴比瑞亞(176例)、肯亞(142例)及迦納(107例)為高,除賴比瑞亞外,其餘近期病例數呈下降趨勢,另剛果民主共和國多省同時流行Ia及Ib型,部分省分受安全情勢與人口流動影響監測能力,病例數有低估情形。 非洲以外地區,羅馬亞通報首例 Ib 型境外移入病例,病患為成年男性,於今年8月確診,曾至中國且具高風險行為,入境後即住院隔離,境內未發現接觸者,後續亦無通報病例;西班牙及荷蘭持續出現Ib型社區傳播;英國12/2通報1例境外移入病例,同時檢出Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之 MPXV 重組病毒株,病況為輕症,現階段對該重組病毒株之流行範圍仍缺乏足夠資訊。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源缺乏,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,惟對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 30 November 2025, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 175,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 467 deaths (CFR: 0.27%). In 2025 up to 30 November, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 206 deaths (CFR: 0.41%). In November 2025, 48 countries and areas reported 2,150 new confirmed cases, including 5 deaths (CFR: 0.27%); 68% came from the African Region. Compared with October, cases rose in the European and Western Pacific Regions and declined in other regions. In the African Region, over the past six weeks (2 November–14 December), 19 countries reported 1,435 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR: 0.5%). The highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (427), Guinea (330), Liberia (176), Kenya (142) and Ghana (107). Except for Liberia, recent case numbers have declined in these countries. In the DRC, multiple provinces are experiencing clade Ia and Ib simultaneously, and in some provinces surveillance capacity is affected by security conditions and population movement, so cases may be underestimated. Outside Africa, Romania reported its first imported clade Ib case, in an adult male diagnosed in August this year who had travelled to China and had high-risk behaviour. He was hospitalised in isolation on arrival, no contacts were identified domestically, and no further cases have been reported. Spain and the Netherlands continue to report clade Ib community transmission. On 2 December, the United Kingdom reported 1 imported case, in which a recombinant MPXV strain containing gene segments of both clade Ib and clade IIb was detected. The case was mild, and there is currently insufficient information on the spread of this recombinant strain. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are lacking, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because asymptomatic infections and cases among travellers to affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, but as moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), particularly those with non-fixed sexual partners. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete epidemiological investigation and contact tracing, and high-risk people are urged to get vaccinated.

kfGeGRPgcDopBa1ulKdwOA.en: Weekly summary. Human cases: China reported 3 new human H9N2 infections. Animal and avian outbreaks (WAHIS): 19 countries reported 534 new H5N1 outbreaks between 19 and 24 December 2025: Germany 405, United States 41, Denmark 27, Sweden 17, Netherlands 10, Norway, Poland and Italy 5 each, Canada and Czechia 3 each, Nigeria, Japan, Finland and Portugal 2 each, and Hungary, Brazil, Belgium, Taiwan and the United Kingdom 1 each. Two countries reported 19 new H5 (N untyped) outbreaks between 16 and 23 December 2025: Belgium 15 and Italy 4. US dairy cattle avian influenza: herds: 1,084 (0) outbreaks have been reported across 19 states since March last year, with recent activity concentrated in Wisconsin. Persons with dairy cattle exposure: at least 9,600 monitored cumulatively and at least 218 tested, of whom 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 50, 454 sampling sites reported results, of which 3 sites in New Jersey, Virginia and California detected H5 positives. Annual summary: human cases this year: 2 H5 (including presumptive) influenza cases, 30 H5N1 influenza cases (992* cumulative since 2003), 1 H5N2 case (2 cumulative), 1 H5N5 case (1 cumulative), 35 H9N2 cases (165 cumulative) and 2 H10N3 cases (6 cumulative). Most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Animal and avian cases: a cumulative total of 71 countries and areas have reported 6,872 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: the FAO/WHO/WOAH risk assessment of H5 viruses dated 28 July finds that H5 viruses (including clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b) remain avian viruses. Human cases have mostly been associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there has been no human-to-human transmission. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as low. For infection risk, the general public remains at low risk, and people who often handle contaminated animals or environments are at low to moderate risk, depending mainly on the type and duration of contact, protection and control measures. Authorities call for strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurised dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sectoral response.

5Whitu5ACKHqPcHlPplPdQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第48週(11/24-30)全球陽性率降至4.06%,其中非洲區署陽性率增加。 中國疫情略增,第50週(12/8-14)門診陽性率為0.5%,較前1週(0.3%)略增,住院陽性率亦上升,整體疫情仍於低點,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情於低點,第50週報告住院數降至99例,陽性率略升為2%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 英國疫情於低點波動,第50週實驗室監測陽性率降至1.9%,住院病例數亦下降,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期呈下降趨勢,其中非洲區署呈上升;近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(63.6%),其次為NB.1.8.1(12.72%),新公告的BA.3.2占比提升至6.71%。鑑於COVID-19仍廣泛傳播,對高風險族群造成嚴重疾病與死亡,WHO之《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合更廣泛的呼吸道和其他傳染病預防和控制計畫,強化冠狀病毒疾病威脅的整合性、永續性且具實證基礎的管理;另WHO新冠疫苗委員會於12/18公告建議以單價LP.8.1作為推薦的疫苗抗原,且JN.1譜系(JN.1或KP.2)仍為合適的替代選項。
5Whitu5ACKHqPcHlPplPdQ.en: Situation update: global test positivity fell to 4.06% in week 48 of 2025 (24–30 November), although it rose in the African Region. China's situation rose slightly: outpatient test positivity was 0.5% in week 50 (8–14 December), up slightly from 0.3% the week before, and hospital test positivity also rose; overall the situation remains at a low level, and NB.1.8.1 is the most common variant. South Korea's situation is at a low level: hospital admissions fell to 99 in week 50 and test positivity rose slightly to 2%, with NB.1.8.1 the most common variant. The United Kingdom's situation fluctuates at a low level: laboratory surveillance test positivity fell to 1.9% in week 50, hospital admissions also declined, and XFG is the most common variant. Assessment and recommendations: global test positivity has recently declined, although it has risen in the African Region. XFG is currently the most common global variant (63.6%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (12.72%), and the newly announced BA.3.2 has risen to 6.71%. Given that COVID-19 continues to spread widely and causes severe disease and deaths among high-risk groups, WHO's strategic plan for managing the threat of coronavirus disease calls on countries to integrate broader respiratory and other infectious disease prevention and control programmes, and to strengthen integrated, sustainable and evidence-based management of the coronavirus disease threat. In addition, the WHO COVID-19 vaccine committee announced on 18 December that monovalent LP.8.1 is recommended as the vaccine antigen, and the JN.1 lineage (JN.1 or KP.2) remains a suitable alternative option.

6LF4K4nG7wRKreqEpbBxMA.en: China reported 56,554 cases in weeks 49–50 (1–14 December), including 20 severe cases and no deaths. Case numbers fell 43% compared with the previous two weeks but remain 134% higher than the same period last year. In Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, the outbreak eased slightly, with 1,484 new cases in week 49, a 17% decrease from the previous week. In South Korea, the situation fluctuated; the outpatient visit positivity rate rose to 5.9 per 1,000 in week 49, higher than the same period over the past three years. In Thailand, the situation declined, with 848 cases reported cumulatively in week 50, lower than the same period last year.

Gi_THUiL6z1tSi80-hqokQ.en: China's overall outbreak continues to rise. In week 49, the sentinel ILI outpatient and emergency visit rate was 9.9%, higher than the same period over the past three years, with test positivity of 49.8%; A(H3N2) is the main circulating type. Authorities say influenza is at a high level of circulation; activity continues to rise in some provinces in East, South and Southwest China, and positivity is rising, though more slowly. Test positivity among those aged 5–14 is higher than in other age groups. Authorities call on nurseries, schools and elderly care homes to strengthen health monitoring and detect and manage clusters early, and urge the public to implement personal hygiene protection measures. The United Kingdom's situation is rising: the average daily number of hospitalised patients in the past week was 2,660, an increase of more than 50% from the previous week. Hospitalisations are highest among those aged 75 and over and under 5, while test positivity is highest among those aged 5–14. Authorities say the outbreak has not yet peaked and could rise to more than 5,000 patients in the short term. This flu season began a month early, mainly because the K subclade of H3N2 is circulating, leaving people without existing immunity and accelerating transmission. Canada's situation is rising: 3,655 cases were reported in week 48, an increase of more than 67% from the previous week, with test positivity of 13%, higher than the same period last year (2%), highest among those under 19. Hospitalisation rates and outbreak numbers have also risen, and the main circulating type is A(H3N2). Since 1 September, 47 H3N2 subclade K viruses have been detected in Canada. Experts say vaccines still provide protection and urge people to get vaccinated as soon as possible.

Sl8VkzOfz7xQObuGJc98Lw.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,第48週(11/24-30)新增1,484例病例,較前4週平均增加0.9%,今年迄今累計達34,127例,該病每年流行高峰期為9-12月;中國疫情自高點下降,11月報告26萬9,337例病例,其中1例死亡,雖較10月疫情(37萬例)略降,惟仍為去年同期4.5倍;韓國疫情下降,第48週就診陽性率5.2‰,仍高於近3年同期;泰國疫情下降,第49週累計報告820例,低於去年同期。
Sl8VkzOfz7xQObuGJc98Lw.en: Ho Chi Minh City, Viet Nam, continues to rise: 1,484 new cases were reported in week 48 (24–30 November), an increase of 0.9% over the average of the previous four weeks. Cumulatively this year, 34,127 cases have been reported. The disease's annual peak season is September to December. China's situation has declined from its peak: 269,337 cases were reported in November, including 1 death. Although this is slightly lower than October (about 370,000 cases), it is 4.5 times the same period last year. South Korea's situation has declined; the outpatient visit positivity rate in week 48 was 5.2 per 1,000, still higher than the same period over the past three years. Thailand's situation has declined; 820 cases were reported cumulatively in week 49, lower than the same period last year.

tIuX2b4tZjOHytG19p9G_Q.en: China's overall outbreak continues to rise. In week 48, the sentinel ILI outpatient and emergency visit rate was 9.6%, higher than the same period over the past three years, with test positivity of 47.8%. Test positivity among those aged 5–14 is higher than in other age groups, and A(H3N2) is the main circulating type. The top three pathogens in sentinel outpatient and emergency respiratory samples were influenza virus (51.1%), rhinovirus (5.3%) and RSV (3.5%); among hospitalised respiratory samples, they were influenza virus (19%), RSV (7.8%) and rhinovirus (7%). Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other spillover outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including a cat death. Wastewater surveillance: in week 38, 432 sampling sites provided test reports, and three states (New Jersey, California and Oregon) had a total of three sampling sites detect H5-positive results. Most cases had prior exposure to susceptible animals. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza is classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 66 countries and areas have reported 3,991 highly and low pathogenic avian influenza outbreaks cumulatively. Human cases have mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and there is no human-to-human transmission capacity. Brazil update: In Cuiabá, the capital of Mato Grosso state, 10,978 confirmed cases and 27 deaths have been reported cumulatively this year. The outbreak remains an important public health issue for the city.

In the past week (28 September–4 October), 3,181 new cases were reported, mainly in Jiangmen city (2,480), followed by Foshan, Guangzhou and Zhaoqing, each with more than 100 new cases. No severe or fatal cases were reported. Jiangmen's outbreak remains at a high level with fluctuations. Some countries and regions had outbreaks this year, including some that had reported few cases in recent years. The Americas have the most cases globally, with Brazil the most severe. France's rise this year is linked to outbreaks in French Réunion and the Indian Ocean area, while the outbreak in French Réunion and Mayotte has declined. In South-East Asia, India has the most cases, and Bangladesh, Thailand and Sri Lanka also reported cases. In the Western Pacific, Guangdong Province, China, had reported 16,452 confirmed cases as of 27 September, distributed across 21 cities, mainly Foshan (10,032) and Jiangmen (5,209), the largest outbreak on record for the country. Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region reported 297 cases from 1 to 21 September, Fujian Province reported 124, and other provinces such as Hunan, Sichuan and Hainan also reported cases. WHO recommends strengthening surveillance, laboratory and healthcare capacity, and vector control to reduce the risk of further spread.

The outpatient and emergency positivity rate in week 38 (15–21 September) was 5.3%, lower than the previous week, and the hospital positivity rate is also declining. The variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. Hong Kong: The outbreak is at a low point. The positivity rate fell to 0.65% in week 38, and the variant NB.1.8.1 has the highest share. United States: The outbreak is declining. The positivity rate in week 37 was 9.5%, having declined for three consecutive weeks; hospitalization rates are also declining, but the mortality rate remains high. The globally circulating variant with the highest share is XFG (72%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (19%). WHO says most countries have included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines to the public, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

hnd_0-1R6OUoI2MeQRySbg.en: Summary for the week. Human cases: Cambodia reported one new human H5N1 infection, and China reported four new human H9N2 infections. Animal (WAHIS) and poultry outbreaks: a total of six countries reported 30 H5N1 outbreaks during 12–19 September 2025, including the UK (15), Canada (6), the USA (4), Germany (2), Norway (2) and Portugal (1). Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,080 (1) herd outbreaks have been reported across 18 states since March last year, with recent cases concentrated mainly in Nebraska. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people have been monitored, 218 tested, and 41 were positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep and alpacas, including one cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 37, 404 sampling sites reported results; three sites in three states (New Jersey, Minnesota and Kansas) detected H5-positive samples. Annual summary. Human cases: this year, one H5 influenza case (including presumptive), 28 H5N1 influenza cases (991* cumulatively since 2003), 26 H9N2 influenza cases (156 cumulatively) and two H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 58 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,289 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e and 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses. Human cases mostly involved direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Because the viruses are widespread in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue. Global public health risk remains low. Risk of infection is low for the general public and low to moderate for people who frequently handle contaminated animals or environments; the main determinants are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for stronger surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

f-_BsAkn4578CQRFUC0UBQ.en: Epidemiological update: in week 35 of 2025 (25–31 August), global test positivity was 13.76%; positivity increased in all WHO regions except South-East Asia and Africa. yooTYuwaZnPn4xQUzx0PCQ.zh: 本週摘要: 人類疫情:本週新增4例中國H9N2流感人類感染病例。 禽/動物疫情(WAHIS):  共5國於2025/9/5-12期間報告17起H5N1疫情,南非 8 起、美國3起、德國/挪威/西班牙各2起。 挪威於2025/9/5報告2起H5 (N untyped)疫情。  美國乳牛感染禽流感案:  牛場:去年3月迄今累計17州報告1,079起疫情,近期主要集中於加州。 人類經牛感染:累計監測至少9,600例,檢測218例,其中41例陽性(結膜炎、呼吸道及流感症狀)。 其他衍生疫情:感染家貓/羊/羊駝等,其中出現貓隻死亡案例。 廢水監測:第36週計422個採檢點提供檢測報告,其中4州(維吉亞州、加州、紐澤西州及阿拉斯加州)共4個採檢點檢出H5陽性。  其他更新:  美國CDC公布加州兒童感染H5N1流感調查報告,病患於去年12/13發病,出現發燒、腹痛、肌肉疼痛及結膜炎症狀,於16-17日就醫,於今年1/9 確診H5流感陽性。經定序結果顯示,為2.3.4.4b分支/ B3.13基因型,與該國乳牛疫情型別一致。病患相關接觸者皆為陰性,流病調查部分,病患居住於城市環境,近期無旅遊史,發病前亦未接觸禽/畜/貓/野生動物,家中飼養犬隻,家人未從事高感染風險職業,惟病患家屬於發病前2週於活禽市場購買生禽,於購買當日宰殺食用,目前感染源仍不明。 研究指出A型流感病毒除引起呼吸道症狀外,亦可能造成腹瀉、嘔吐、腹痛等腸胃道症狀。近期美國乳牛感染H5N1並有零星人類感染,顯示病毒具食源性感染之公共衛生風險。該研究顯示季節性與新型A型流感腸胃道併發症的頻率,相關證據顯示A型流感及H5N1流感可在哺乳動物腸胃組織中複製,顯示哺乳動物攝入含病毒物質感染可能性。胃部暴露可能為H5N1流感感染哺乳動物的非呼吸道途徑,多種暴露路徑下可能於腸道檢測到病毒。  年度摘要:  人類病例:今年累計報告H5(含推測)流感1例,H5N1流感27例 (2003年迄今累計990*例),H9N2流感22例(迄今累計150例),H10N3流感2例(迄今累計6例),個案發病前多有易感動物相關暴露史。*依WHO統計將美國H5流感列為H5N1流感病例。 禽類/動物案例:累計58國家/地區通報2,263起高/低病原性禽流感疫情。  評估與建議: FAO/WHO/WOAH於7/28針對H5病毒風險評估,H5病毒(2.3.2.1a、2.3.2.1e及2.3.4.4b等)仍屬禽類病毒,人類病例多曾直/間接接觸易感動物或受其汙染環境相關,且未具人際傳播能力,基於病毒廣泛存在於野生/飼養動物,預期仍會持續出現病例,評估全球公共衛生風險仍低;感染風險部分,一般大眾仍為低,於常接觸受汙染動物/環境者則為低至中,主要因素為接觸方式、時間、防護及管控措施等,呼籲加強對易感動物及高危險人群之監測,並避免飲用未經高溫殺菌之乳品,持續採取防疫一體(One Health)跨部門應對措施。
yooTYuwaZnPn4xQUzx0PCQ.en: Summary for the week. Human cases: four new human H9N2 infections were reported in China this week. Animal and poultry outbreaks (WAHIS): a total of five countries reported 17 H5N1 outbreaks during 5–12 September 2025, including South Africa (8), USA (3), and Germany, Norway and Spain (2 each). Norway reported two H5 (N-untyped) outbreaks on 5 September 2025. Avian influenza in US dairy cattle: 1,079 herd outbreaks have been reported across 17 states since March last year, recently concentrated mainly in California. Human infections linked to cattle: at least 9,600 people monitored, 218 tested, and 41 positive (conjunctivitis, respiratory and influenza-like symptoms). Other derived outbreaks: infections in domestic cats, sheep, alpacas and others, including one cat death. Wastewater monitoring: in week 36, 422 sampling sites provided results, and four sites in four states (Virginia, California, New Jersey and Alaska) detected H5-positive samples. Other updates: the US CDC published an investigation report on a child in California infected with H5N1 influenza. The child fell ill on 13 December last year with fever, abdominal pain, muscle pain and conjunctivitis, sought medical care on 16–17 December, and was confirmed H5 influenza-positive on 9 January this year. Sequencing showed clade 2.3.4.4b, genotype B3.13, consistent with the country's dairy cattle outbreak strains. All of the patient's contacts tested negative. The epidemiological investigation found that the patient lived in an urban environment with no recent travel history, had no exposure to poultry, livestock, cats or wild animals before onset, and kept dogs at home. No family member had a high-risk occupation. However, family members bought live poultry at a live-poultry market two weeks before the patient's onset and slaughtered and ate it on the day of purchase. The infection source remains unknown. A study notes that influenza A viruses can cause gastrointestinal symptoms such as diarrhoea, vomiting and abdominal pain in addition to respiratory symptoms. Recent H5N1 infections in US dairy cattle and sporadic human infections suggest a public health risk of foodborne transmission. The study reports the frequency of gastrointestinal complications of seasonal and novel influenza A; evidence indicates that influenza A and H5N1 can replicate in mammalian gut tissue, suggesting possible infection of mammals through ingestion of virus-containing material. Gastric exposure may be a non-respiratory route of H5N1 infection in mammals, and the virus may be detected in the intestine under various exposure routes. Annual summary. Human cases: this year, one H5 (including presumptive) influenza case, 27 H5N1 influenza cases (990* cumulatively since 2003), 22 H9N2 influenza cases (150 cumulatively) and two H10N3 influenza cases (6 cumulatively); most cases had exposure to susceptible animals before onset. *Per WHO statistics, US H5 influenza cases are classified as H5N1 cases. Avian and animal cases: 58 countries and regions have cumulatively reported 2,263 high- and low-pathogenicity avian influenza outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: On 28 July, FAO, WHO and WOAH completed a risk assessment of H5 viruses. H5 viruses (clades 2.3.2.1a, 2.3.2.1e, 2.3.4.4b, among others) remain avian viruses; human cases were mostly associated with direct or indirect contact with susceptible animals or contaminated environments, and the viruses have no human-to-human transmission capacity. Given their widespread presence in wild and farmed animals, cases are expected to continue, and global public health risk is assessed as remaining low. The infection risk for the general public remains low, and low to moderate for people who frequently contact contaminated animals or environments; the main determinants are the mode and duration of contact, protective measures and control measures. Authorities call for enhanced surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups, avoidance of drinking unpasteurized dairy products, and continued One Health cross-sector response.

Qy4fJyUrq-lvedilIMsy7w.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第34週(8/18-24)全球陽性率10.85%,美洲、歐洲及非洲區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點波動,8月新增約16萬例病例,其中重症187例、死亡7例,陽性率下降8%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(95.2%)。 香港疫情下降,第36週陽性率下降至1.1%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 日本疫情略降,第35週定醫平均報告數7.46,較前一週(8.8)下降,病患以10歲以下為多,地理分布以大阪、埼玉縣為多。 美國疫情經高點後稍降,第35週陽性率降為10.8%,惟已超過今年年初高峰(6.7%),死亡率呈上升,住院率呈下降趨勢,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(64%),其次為NB.1.8.1(27%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
Qy4fJyUrq-lvedilIMsy7w.en: Epidemiological update: in week 34 of 2025 (18–24 August), global test positivity was 10.85%, with increases in the Americas, Europe and Africa regions. China's outbreak is fluctuating at a low level; about 160,000 cases were reported in August, including 187 severe cases and 7 deaths; positivity declined by 8%, and variant NB.1.8.1 accounts for the largest share (95.2%). Hong Kong's outbreak is declining; positivity fell to 1.1% in week 36, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Japan's outbreak has declined slightly: the sentinel average in week 35 was 7.46, down from 8.8 the previous week. Patients are mostly under 10 years old, and cases are geographically concentrated in Osaka and Saitama Prefecture. The US outbreak has declined slightly from its peak: positivity fell to 10.8% in week 35, but remains above this year's early-year peak (6.7%); mortality is rising and hospitalization rates are declining, with XFG the variant with the largest share. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward. XFG is the predominant global variant (64%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (27%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

jHoOofOtoxT7HemDNxL9Sw.zh: 中國遼寧省瀋陽市某大學於8/31爆發群聚疫情,報告2,087例病例,皆為輕症,持續新增病例;當局經採檢調查,疑感染源為蓄水池遭諾羅病毒汙染所致。
jHoOofOtoxT7HemDNxL9Sw.en: A university in Shenyang City, Liaoning Province, China, experienced a cluster outbreak starting on 31 August, with 2,087 cases reported. All cases were mild, and new cases continue to be reported. Sampling and investigation by authorities suggest that the suspected source was contamination of a water storage tank with norovirus.

aYQYXWyrbEWo61Oh1Fj6JQ.zh: 香港公布中國新增4例H9N2流感人類感染病例,發病時間介於7/28-8/21間,分布於安徽省/重慶市/湖南省/四川省,病患皆為6歲以下男童,其他流病資訊不明。該國今年累計報告22例H9N2流感人類感染病例。 美國CDC於9/8發布風險評估,表示透過食用或飲用受污染食物或飲品可能感染新型A型流感,近期研究顯示季節性流感及新型A型流感可能感染腸胃道,並透過非呼吸道傳播方式傳染其他哺乳動物。CDC評估透過消化系統接觸為人類及其他哺乳動物感染H5N1流感病毒之潛在途徑,雖目前尚無與飲用受汙染牛乳感染相關病例,惟近2年出現部分感染源不明之人類感染病例,並有寵物貓食用受病毒汙染之食品感染並死亡,表示風險雖低,惟仍可能發生,呼籲民眾避免生飲牛乳或生食乳製品。
aYQYXWyrbEWo61Oh1Fj6JQ.en: Hong Kong announced four new human H9N2 infections in China, with onset between 28 July and 21 August, distributed across Anhui Province, Chongqing Municipality, Hunan Province and Sichuan Province. All patients were boys under 6 years old; other epidemiological information is unknown. China has reported 22 human H9N2 infections cumulatively this year. The US CDC issued a risk assessment on 8 September, stating that novel influenza A may be contracted through eating or drinking contaminated food or beverages. Recent studies show that seasonal and novel influenza A can infect the gastrointestinal tract and spread to other mammals through non-respiratory routes. The CDC assesses that digestive-tract exposure is a potential route of H5N1 influenza infection for humans and other mammals. Although no cases have yet been linked to drinking contaminated milk, some human infections of unknown source have emerged in the past two years, and a pet cat died after eating contaminated food. The CDC says the risk is low but still possible, and urges the public to avoid drinking raw milk or eating raw dairy products.

zc2Ro61WHIGiMhbjyKQp5A.zh: 中國江蘇省南通市通州區9/9新增1例病例,病患已痊癒,感染源疑為農貿市場,迄未發現新增病例;當局正進行疫情調查、環境採檢及清消作業。
zc2Ro61WHIGiMhbjyKQp5A.en: Tongzhou District, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province, China, reported one new case on 9 September; the patient has recovered. The suspected source is a farmers' market, and no further new cases have been found. Authorities are conducting an outbreak investigation, environmental sampling and disinfection.

6G9eUu9ssXglNnsiI-XBJw.en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease: in the past week (31 August–6 September), 178 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 85 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 40. Case numbers show a downward trend; because the risk of importation continues, vector mosquitoes remain active in some areas, and climatic factors, vector control work continues locally. Europe outbreak update: France reported 74 new locally acquired cases in the past week, bringing its cumulative total this year to 301 locally acquired cases. Italy has cumulatively reported 107 locally acquired cases this year.

040uF6Qi5xY2f5rrrS6OyA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第33週(8/11-17)全球陽性率8.64%,美洲及歐洲區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情下降,第35週定醫門診陽性率下降至8.5%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 香港疫情下降,第35週陽性率下降至1.34%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(76%)。 日本疫情處高點,第33週定醫平均報告數8.76,較前一週(6.3)上升,病患以50-59歲為多,地理分布以愛知縣、大阪為多。 美國疫情持續上升,第34週陽性率11.2%,已超過今年年初高峰(6.7%),新增134例死亡,以變異株XFG占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲及歐洲區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(67%),其次為NB.1.8.1(23%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
040uF6Qi5xY2f5rrrS6OyA.en: Epidemiological update: in week 33 of 2025 (11–17 August), global test positivity was 8.64%, with increases in the Americas and European regions. China's outbreak has declined: sentinel outpatient positivity fell to 8.5% in week 35, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. XFG is the predominant global variant (67%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (23%). f1TBWf2QH2FqKtO5vbktgg.zh: 中國廣東省疫情趨緩,近1週(8/24-30)新增225例病例,未報告重症及死亡病例,以佛山市119例最多,其次為廣州市49例,相較於前1週新增336例,病例數呈下降趨勢,當局持續進行疫情防治工作。 全球今年截至8月中旬累計逾270,000例病例,美洲地區累計14國報告212,029例病例及110例死亡,主要分布於南美洲(玻利維亞、巴西、巴拉圭)及部分加勒比地區,此外,於印度洋、歐洲及亞洲之持續疫情,提升不同基因型共同循環之可能性,大幅增加其再度傳播及蔓延之風險。
f1TBWf2QH2FqKtO5vbktgg.en: Guangdong Province, China, has seen its outbreak ease: in the past week (24–30 August), 225 new cases were reported, with no severe or fatal cases. Foshan City had the most, with 119 cases, followed by Guangzhou City with 49. Compared with 336 new cases in the previous week, case numbers are declining. Authorities continue outbreak prevention and control work. Globally, as of mid-August this year, more than 270,000 cases had been cumulatively reported. The Americas region has cumulatively reported 212,029 cases and 110 deaths from 14 countries, mainly in South America (Bolivia, Brazil and Paraguay) and parts of the Caribbean. In addition, ongoing outbreaks in the Indian Ocean, Europe and Asia increase the likelihood of different genotypes circulating together, which greatly increases the risk of renewed transmission and spread.

jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.en: Global monthly outbreak update: since May 2022 and as of 28 August this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 158,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 399 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 35, 84 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 37,000 confirmed cases: African Region 31,980; Region of the Americas 2,825; European Region 1,858; Western Pacific Region 1,067; South-East Asia Region 82; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. The rise in the Western Pacific is attributed to China and the Philippines each reporting more than 100 new cases in July this year alone. Other updates: Kenya's outbreak is rising. Since the first case was reported in July 2024, 370 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported as of 17 August this year, including 6 deaths, five of which were in people living with HIV. Cases are concentrated in Mombasa, the country's second-largest port city in the south-east. More than half of patients are young adults aged 20–40. About 45% of the country's counties (21 of 47) have reported cases. Sexual transmission is the main driver of spread, particularly among truck drivers, sex workers and traders along the main East African transnational highway. China reported one new clade Ib case on 1 August: an adult male traveller who reported symptoms upon entry in mid-July. Authorities launched an epidemiological investigation and preventive measures. Macao reported its first imported case of this year on 27 August, the third case in the region since 2023 (the first two were reported in 2023). The patient is a 29-year-old male Macao resident who developed fever, sore throat and diarrhoea on 23 August. He had sought care on the mainland and returned to Macao for treatment on 26 August, where the infection was confirmed. The patient had high-risk sexual behaviour during travel, but did not disclose the location. Germany reported one new clade Ib case on 19 August: an adult male traveller with a travel history to the United Arab Emirates. Authorities have traced contacts and are monitoring symptoms. Turkey reported three clade Ib cases. One recent case was confirmed in late July and had a travel history to the UAE and Egypt; the other two were retrospective cases with a travel history to Uganda. Authorities have conducted epidemiological investigation and isolation measures. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported its first two confirmed clade IIb cases. The index case is an adult male with a travel history to Côte d'Ivoire; analysis shows the sequence matches cases in Côte d'Ivoire and Nigeria. Case 2 is a contact of the index case; authorities have traced 25 contacts, 23 of whom received post-exposure vaccination. This is the country's first detection of clade IIb, indicating that clade IIb has entered areas where clade Ia/Ib circulates, increasing public risk. Assessment and recommendations: WHO announced that the long-term recommended measures, originally due to expire on 20 August 2025, will be extended by one year in view of the global epidemiological situation, to prevent and reduce international transmission and its health impact. It emphasizes that continued surveillance, scientific research, community cooperation and equitable resource allocation are the core of global prevention and control for 2025–26. Seven areas of recommendation are: continued optimization of national plans and policies; building surveillance and laboratory diagnostic capacity; strengthening community protection and risk communication; promoting research and clinical trials; formulating travel-related measures (travel bans are not encouraged); providing optimal clinical care and health-worker protection; and ensuring equitable access to vaccines, diagnostics and treatment.

UQ4nSMsNJGERoUXXqVDmNA.en: Kerala State, India, update: as of 23 August this year, 11 confirmed cases had been cumulatively reported, one of them fatal. The deceased was a 9-year-old girl in Kozhikode District; her 7-year-old younger brother was also confirmed and hospitalized. Both cases had bathed in the same pond. Case numbers in the district are rising, and experts suspect that a different new strain may be responsible for recent cases. Authorities have issued an outbreak alert for the district. China reported two deaths in August. Case 1 was a 5-year-old girl in Fujian Province (previously identified): she was hospitalized on 23 June, fell into a coma and was transferred to intensive care, and died on 22 August; before onset she had been swimming and bathing in hot springs. Case 2 was a 6-year-old boy in Anhui Province who developed fever on 17 June; after repeated medical visits, he was transferred to a Shanghai hospital on 27 June, confirmed on 30 June, and died on 11 August. Before onset he had fished in a park and played in water at school. 3HrwodqV9WjRs-pGLx7qMw.zh: 中國今年截至6月累計報告3萬3,959例病例,其中1例死亡,病例數低於去年同期(3萬7,021例);另2024年全年累計報告6萬7,418例,其中3例死亡;該國2004-22年平均發生率為每10萬人口5例,疫情盛行於春夏季,呈逐年增加趨勢,北部省份發生率高(如新疆、內蒙古及黑龍江等)。 中國新疆2021-23年累計報告1萬8,094例病例,年均發生率為每10萬人口23例,病患年齡以30-60歲為多(占73%),男性占7成,常見職業為農民、牧民,病患分佈以伊犁哈薩克自治州、昌吉回族自治州等為主。
3HrwodqV9WjRs-pGLx7qMw.en: China reported 33,959 cases cumulatively this year as of June, including one death; case numbers are lower than in the same period last year (37,021). The disease peaks in spring and summer and has been increasing year by year, with higher incidence in northern provinces such as Xinjiang, Inner Mongolia and Heilongjiang. In Xinjiang, 18,094 cases were reported cumulatively in 2021–23, an average annual incidence of 23 per 100,000 population. Patients are mostly aged 30–60 years (73%) and 70% are male; common occupations are farmers and herders. Cases are mainly distributed in Ili Kazakh Autonomous Prefecture and Changji Hui Autonomous Prefecture, among others.

3KSVpamW84ZvYJgvlVQ6dw.zh: 中國廣東省疫情嚴峻,該省近1週新增2,892例病例,以佛山市最多(2,770例),其次為廣州市(65例),疫情分布地區擴大,惠州市亦出現病例;佛山市截至7/31累計逾6,900例病例,該省其他城市近期亦出現病例,並於澳門及香港等地出現移入病例,澳門近日已報告2例本土病例。
3KSVpamW84ZvYJgvlVQ6dw.en: Guangdong Province, China, has a severe outbreak: 2,892 new cases were reported in the past week, mainly in Foshan City (2,770), followed by Guangzhou City (65). The affected area has expanded, and Huizhou City has also reported cases. As of 31 July, Foshan City had cumulatively reported more than 6,900 cases. Other cities in the province have also recently reported cases, and imported cases have appeared in Macao and Hong Kong. Macao has recently reported two local cases.

INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年6月截至今年7/25累計139國/地區報告15萬4千餘例確診病例,其中至少385例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第30週累計79國/地區報告3萬3,370例確診病例,其中非洲區2萬8,481例、美洲區2,343例、歐洲區1,706例、西太平洋區755例、東南亞區52例及東地中海區33例。  其他更新:  中國今年截至7/31報告23例Ib型確診病例,其中7例具疫區旅遊史,包含烏干達(2例)、坦尚亞(2例)、剛果民主共和國(2例)、西非國家(剛果、馬利),另2例具泊爾及1例具阿拉伯聯合大公國旅遊史,其餘個案為本土傳播,其中,包含居住在中國之非洲僑民。WHO基於所有通報群聚事件中,指標個案均能與旅遊史有流行病學關聯,故將該國傳播分類由「未知傳播鏈」更正為「與旅遊相關個案」,惟仍無法排除尚未偵測到之社區傳播可能性。當局已在疫區進行廢水監測,並加強衛教及提供無症狀者藥物。 澳大利亞7/19報告新增2例Ib型病例,案1近期有烏干達旅遊史,案2為案1家庭接觸者,當局已加強監測疫情。 英國7/22新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性,具肯亞旅遊史,當局已展開疫調與監測,並提供接觸者疫苗。  評估與建議: WHO於2025年6月5日召開國際衛生條例(IHR)緊急委員會第四次會議,討論2024年M痘疫情上升的情形。會議確認該事件仍構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並針對受影響國家提出各項臨時建議,包括加強監測、提升診斷能力、推動疫苗接種、改善臨床護理、強化跨境合作,以及加強社區參與和資金支持,並將現行建議延長至2025年8月20日。
INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.en: Monthly update: since June 2022 and as of 25 July this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 154,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 385 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 30, 79 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 33,370 confirmed cases: African Region 28,481; Region of the Americas 2,343; European Region 1,706; Western Pacific Region 755; South-East Asia Region 52; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. Other updates: China reported 23 confirmed clade Ib cases as of 31 July this year, of which seven had travel history to affected areas, including Uganda (2), Tanzania (2), the DRC (2), and West African countries (Congo, Mali); two had travel history to Nepal and one to the UAE. The other cases were locally transmitted, including African nationals living in China. Based on all reported clusters in which the index cases had epidemiological links to travel, WHO has reclassified China's transmission category from 'unknown transmission chain' to 'travel-associated cases', although undetected community transmission cannot be ruled out. Authorities have launched wastewater surveillance in affected areas, strengthened health education, and provided medicines to asymptomatic people. Australia reported two new clade Ib cases on 19 July: case 1 had recent travel history to Uganda, and case 2 was a household contact of case 1; authorities have strengthened surveillance. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 22 July, an adult male with travel history to Kenya; authorities have launched epidemiological investigation and surveillance and provided vaccines to contacts. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the fourth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on 5 June 2025 to discuss the rise in mpox since 2024. The meeting confirmed that the event still constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), and issued temporary recommendations for affected countries, including strengthening surveillance, improving diagnostic capacity, promoting vaccination, improving clinical care, strengthening cross-border cooperation, and enhancing community engagement and financial support. Current recommendations were extended to 20 August 2025.

ZjfCLNEOzhJtxL3zSxpwUA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第28週(7/7-13)全球陽性率4.54%,美洲及歐洲區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情上下波動,第30週(7/21-27)定醫門診陽性率13.5%,較前1週略減,其中,南方省份陽性率高於北方,住院陽性率呈下降趨勢,變異株以NB.1.8.1為主。 香港疫情呈下降趨勢,第30週陽性率1.89%,已連續10週下降,定醫就診率亦下降,污水監測數據顯示,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(88.1%),另XFG占1.7%。 日本疫情呈上升趨勢,第29週(7/14-20)新增12,069例,較上週增加30%,病患分佈以東京都及神奈川縣為主,年齡分布以50-59歲及10歲以下為多,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。 韓國疫情上升,第30週新增住院病例139例,已連續4週上升,陽性率達20.1%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、東地中海、東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株由XFG占比最高(49%),其次為NB.1.8.1(29.26%)及LP.8.1(10%)。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
ZjfCLNEOzhJtxL3zSxpwUA.en: Epidemiological update: in week 28 of 2025 (7–13 July), global test positivity was 4.54%, with increases in the Americas and European regions. China's outbreak is fluctuating: sentinel outpatient positivity was 13.5% in week 30 (21–27 July), slightly lower than the previous week; positivity is higher in southern provinces than northern ones, inpatient positivity is declining, and NB.1.8.1 is the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak is declining: positivity was 1.89% in week 30, down for 10 consecutive weeks; sentinel visit rates have also declined; wastewater surveillance data show NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (88.1%), with XFG at 1.7%. Japan's outbreak is rising: 12,069 new cases were reported in week 29 (14–20 July), up 30% from the previous week; patients are mainly in Tokyo Metropolis and Kanagawa Prefecture, with the largest age groups being 50–59 years and under 10 years, and NB.1.8.1 is the predominant variant. South Korea's outbreak is rising: 139 new hospitalizations were reported in week 30, rising for four consecutive weeks, with positivity reaching 20.1%, and NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with the Americas, Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia regions rising. The predominant global variant is XFG (49%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (29.26%) and LP.8.1 (10%). WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

kSV9_nmOQutlPzyFfTYUxQ.zh: 中歐國家疫情升高,今年截至6月累計報告逾2,000例,9例死亡,其中斯洛伐克880例、捷克600例、匈牙利530例、奧地利87例,德國3起個案與匈牙利病例基因序列一致,顯示疾病跨域傳播,惟未發現疫情蔓延。ECDC表示此波疫情流行主要為IB型之2個基因群組,影響包括遊民、吸毒者及居住不良衛生環境族群,評估大於40歲為高風險族群,呼籲加強疫苗接種及衛生措施。 中國今年截至6月累計報告逾1.1萬例病例,高於去年同期(7,500例)。
kSV9_nmOQutlPzyFfTYUxQ.en: Hepatitis A is rising in Central European countries. As of June this year, more than 2,000 cases and 9 deaths have been reported cumulatively: Slovakia 880, Czech Republic 600, Hungary 530 and Austria 87. Three cases in Germany have genetic sequences identical to Hungarian cases, indicating cross-border transmission, although no wider spread has been detected. The ECDC says this wave is mainly caused by two genogroups of genotype IB, affecting homeless people, people who use drugs, and people living in poor sanitary conditions. People over 40 are assessed as high-risk, and the ECDC calls for stronger vaccination and hygiene measures. China has reported more than 11,000 cases as of June this year, higher than the 7,500 cases in the same period last year.

4vrpLk6Moei-p3ZWbwHmSw.en: Guangdong Province, China, has a severe outbreak. As of 26 July, more than 4,800 cumulative cases have been reported, all mild, with no severe or fatal cases. In the past week (20–26 July), 2,940 new cases were reported, most of them in Foshan City (2,882), followed by Guangzhou (22) and Zhongshan (18). Imported cases have also appeared in areas including Macao.

2ijc5OCJHTfY7tdvCeM6Yg.en: Foshan City in Guangdong Province, China, has provided an update on its outbreak. Since the first imported case that gave rise to this wave was reported on 8 July, more than 4,000 cumulative cases have been reported as of 25 July, mainly in Shunde District. The imported virus is an Indian Ocean lineage, which is particularly easily transmitted by mosquitoes, and most areas of the country have entered a period of rapid mosquito growth and spread. Foshan has prepared 53 hospitals with a total of 7,220 mosquito-proof isolation beds, and patients are required to receive inpatient isolation treatment.

QUNnz_4491c4HG5sIhJ6IQ.en: Epidemic update: Globally, the positivity rate in week 27 of 2025 (30 June–6 July) was 4.19%, with increases in the Americas, Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia regions. pJGLF4YrSDUJD9um5-aaQg.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 27–29 (29 June–19 July): China's epidemic has peaked, with about 105,000 new cases, including 43 severe cases; new cases were 20% higher than in the previous two weeks. -JMQt5P-91fJ1hycc3tTjw.zh: 中國廣東省佛山市疫情遽升,自7/8報告衍生此波疫情之首例境外移入病例以來,截至7/23累計達3,195例病例,佛山市5個區均有病例,且皆為輕症,以順德區2,934例最多,其次為禪城區147例、南海區107例;廣東於2010年首次報告由境外移入病例引起本土傳播後,於部分地區曾發生較小規模疫情,惟未曾發生大規模疫情。澳門截至7/22累計2例病例且均有佛山市旅居史。估計全球有119個國家共56億人生活在面臨該病毒風險之地區,世界衛生組織已於7月22日緊急呼籲各國應採取行動。
-JMQt5P-91fJ1hycc3tTjw.en: Foshan City in Guangdong Province, China, has seen a sharp rise in cases. Since the first imported case that gave rise to this wave was reported on 8 July, 3,195 cumulative cases had been reported as of 23 July. All five districts of Foshan have cases, all mild, with Shunde District the most at 2,934, followed by Chancheng District with 147 and Nanhai District with 107. Guangdong first reported local transmission from an imported case in 2010 and has had smaller outbreaks in some areas since, but no large-scale outbreak. Macao had 2 cumulative cases as of 22 July, both with a history of travel to Foshan. An estimated 5.6 billion people in 119 countries live in areas at risk from this virus, and WHO issued an urgent call on 22 July for countries to take action.

OxqR6fTbIlPRnn-AfWcw9w.zh: 法國疫情更新,今年截至7/16本土病例累計30例,境外移入病例累計799例,當局表示過去疫情集中於南部地區,現已傳播至原本無疫情地區,包括東北部之大東部大區(Grand Est)以及西南部之新阿基坦大區(Nouvelle-Aquitaine),另警告本土傳播風險仍高,預期病例數持續上升。 中國廣東省佛山市自7/8報告首例境外移入後,截至7/19已累計1,199例病例,均為輕症病例,分布於佛山市順德區、南海區及禪城區。澳門7/18報告該地區今年首例,病患為61歲男性澳門居民,7/8-17前往佛山市順德區探親,17日早上出現發燒、頭痛及全身肌肉關節痛症狀,18日確診,已住院治療,同居者迄無症狀。
OxqR6fTbIlPRnn-AfWcw9w.en: France has updated its situation. As of 16 July this year, 30 locally acquired cases and 799 imported cases have been reported cumulatively. Authorities said past outbreaks were concentrated in the south but have now spread to areas that previously had no cases, including the Grand Est region in the northeast and Nouvelle-Aquitaine in the southwest. They warn that the risk of local transmission remains high and that case numbers are expected to keep rising. In Foshan City, Guangdong Province, China, 1,199 cumulative cases had been reported as of 19 July since the first imported case was reported on 8 July. All were mild and distributed across Shunde, Nanhai and Chancheng districts. Macao reported its first case of the year on 18 July: a 61-year-old male resident who visited relatives in Shunde District, Foshan, from 8 to 17 July. Strengthened surveillance of susceptible animals and high-risk groups is recommended.

bjd7Ue6BgaDQlPXFrX7F_w.en: Monthly update: as of 20 April this year, 132 countries and regions have reported 138,085 confirmed mpox cases cumulatively since May 2022, including at least 317 deaths (CFR 0.2%). Other updates: WHO reported that between 28 March and 20 April, 4 countries (the United Kingdom, France, Switzerland and Thailand) reported 4 new clade Ib cases, and China reported 2 new clade Ia cases; most had travel history to Central Africa. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the third meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on the 2024 mpox outbreak on 25 February 2025. It stated that the outbreak remains severe, the scale of the outbreak in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains unclear, the number of countries reporting clade Ib infections has multiplied internationally, and reduced funding is affecting access to vaccine and diagnostic resources. It therefore declared that this wave of the outbreak continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Risk assessment by clade: clade Ia, transmission risk in the DRC is moderate; clade Ib, transmission risk in the DRC and neighboring areas is high; clade II, transmission risk in Nigeria and across Central and West Africa is moderate; clade IIb, international transmission risk is moderate.

cGNF2RXTPMlUva8rZjjhJg.zh: 亞洲部分國家疫情上升,中國今年1、2月各報告約2,200例病例,為去年同期2倍;日本今年截至4/6累計報告41例病例,高於去年同期(26例);印度今年截至2/23累計報告10起群聚案件,高於去年同期(2起),病患多分布於南部喀拉拉邦(Kerala);韓國今年截至4/12累計報告360例病例,與去年同期(369例)相當;泰國今年截至3/22累計報告189例病例,第11-12週(3/9-3/22)疫情下降。
cGNF2RXTPMlUva8rZjjhJg.en: Outbreaks are rising in some Asian countries. China reported about 2,200 cases in each of January and February this year, double the same period last year. Japan reported 41 cases cumulatively this year as of 6 April, higher than the 26 in the same period last year. India reported 10 clusters cumulatively this year as of 23 February, higher than the 2 in the same period last year, with cases mainly in Kerala State in the south. South Korea reported 360 cases cumulatively this year as of 12 April, comparable to the 369 in the same period last year. Thailand reported 189 cases cumulatively this year as of 22 March, and the outbreak declined in weeks 11–12 (9–22 March).

yVJpyCAWg4nteF9dDYTC-g.zh: 中國廣東省3月報告逾1,500例,較2月增加640餘例,當地猩紅熱流行高峰於4至6月間,當局提醒家長應為孩童做好個人防護,減少交叉感染風險。
yVJpyCAWg4nteF9dDYTC-g.en: Guangdong Province in China reported more than 1,500 cases in March, an increase of more than 640 over February. The local scarlet fever epidemic peaks between April and June, and authorities remind parents to take personal protective measures for their children to reduce the risk of cross-infection.

QHfk-KVN167ZcwmRdfmIMA.zh: WHO於2/13公布:  阿拉伯聯合大公國於2/7報告該國首例Ib型確診病例,具烏干達旅遊史,1/11出現症狀,18日確診,目前隔離治療中。迄今已累計7例自該國之輸出病例(3例泰國、中國/阿曼/巴基斯坦/印度各1例),推測該國可能有未知之社區傳播鏈。 中國自1/3起截至2/5累計7例Ib型確診病例,首例為1/3報告,具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,二次傳播至其餘5人;另1起為1/21報告新增1例病例,具阿拉伯聯合大公國旅遊史。
QHfk-KVN167ZcwmRdfmIMA.en: WHO reported on 13 February that the United Arab Emirates reported its first clade Ib confirmed case on 7 February, with a travel history to Uganda. Symptoms began on 11 January and the case was confirmed on 18 January; the patient is in isolation for treatment. So far, 7 exported cases from the UAE have been recorded: 3 in Thailand, and 1 each in China, Oman, Pakistan and India. Authorities suspect there may be an unknown community transmission chain in the UAE. Mainland China has reported 7 clade Ib confirmed cases cumulatively from 3 January to 5 February. The first case, reported on 3 January, had a travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and transmitted the virus to 5 others. Another case, reported on 21 January, was newly added and had a travel history to the UAE.

ZtyZujjRJ2pOqc0q6xAjOA.zh: 中國公布第5週(1/27-2/2)全國呼吸道傳染病監視情形,近期呼吸道傳染病於該國呈現下降趨勢;主要檢出病原體為流感病毒,目前仍處流行期,惟活動度呈下降趨勢,當局表示目前仍為呼吸道傳染病流行期,且適逢春節期間,人流活動及聚會增加,疾病傳播風險仍高。
ZtyZujjRJ2pOqc0q6xAjOA.en: China published national surveillance data on respiratory infectious diseases for week 5 (27 January–2 February). Respiratory infections in the country have recently shown a declining trend. The main pathogen detected is influenza virus, and the country remains in its influenza epidemic period, although activity is declining. Authorities state that the country is still in the respiratory infectious disease epidemic period, and as the Spring Festival coincides with this period, population movement and gatherings have increased, so the risk of transmission remains high.

VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.zh: 多國疫情上升,病例數高於歷年同期:  亞洲:中國去(2024)年報告49萬餘例,為2023年14倍,近期疫情已趨緩,病例數已降至單月1萬例以下;韓國去年報告逾4.7萬例,今(2025)年迄今報告已逾1,600例,遠高於往年單年不超過千例水平;日本病例數持續上升,近期處高點,惟疫情仍低於新冠疫情前規模;越南去年報告1,000餘例,為2023年21.9倍。 大洋洲:澳洲於去年報告逾5.7萬例病例,為2023年23.3倍,今年初疫情持續,迄今累計報告逾3,000例;紐西蘭自去年10月中旬迄今累計報告1,200餘例,其中101例住院,1例死亡。 美洲:美國去年累計報告3.5萬餘例,為2023年同期的6倍,近期病例數呈上升趨勢;巴西去年報告逾6,000例,為2014年以來新高。
VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.en: Several countries have seen rising case numbers, above same-period levels in previous years. Asia: China reported over 490,000 cases last year (2024), 14 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak has recently eased, and monthly cases have fallen below 10,000. South Korea reported over 47,000 cases last year, and so far this year (2025) more than 1,600 cases, far above the level of previous years, when no single year exceeded 1,000 cases. Japan's case numbers continue to rise and are currently near a peak, although the outbreak remains below the scale seen before the COVID-19 pandemic. Viet Nam reported over 1,000 cases last year, 21.9 times the 2023 figure. Oceania: Australia reported over 57,000 cases last year, 23.3 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak continued into early this year, with over 3,000 cases reported so far. New Zealand has reported over 1,200 cases cumulatively since mid-October last year, of which 101 were hospitalised and 1 died. Americas: The United States reported over 35,000 cases last year, six times the same period of 2023, and case numbers are rising. Brazil reported over 6,000 cases last year, the highest since 2014.

GyMoOuXdfYmNS0jaySX67g.zh: 中國流感陽性率於2025年第1週(2024/12/30-2025/1/5)較前1週(2024/12/23-12/29)上升3.8%,上升趨緩並低於去年同期,且學校陸續放假,評估本月中下旬流感活動將下降,惟不同省分間情形略有差異。當局表示發熱門診、急診患者數呈現上升趨勢,低於去年同期水準,且未出現醫療資源明顯緊張情況。另人類間質肺炎陽性率成波動趨勢,惟北方省分陽性率上升趨緩,14歲以下患者陽性率下降;0-4歲幼童RSV陽性率則呈上升趨勢。
GyMoOuXdfYmNS0jaySX67g.en: China's influenza positivity rate in week 1 of 2025 (30 December 2024–5 January 2025) rose by 3.8% from the previous week (23–29 December 2024). The increase is slowing and is lower than the same period last year, and schools are gradually closing for the holidays. The assessment is that influenza activity will decline in the middle and latter part of this month, although conditions vary somewhat among provinces. Authorities state that fever clinic and emergency patient numbers are rising, but remain below the level of the same period last year, and no obvious strain on medical resources has been observed. In addition, the human metapneumovirus positivity rate has fluctuated; in northern provinces the increase is slowing, and the positivity rate among patients aged 14 and under has declined. The RSV positivity rate among young children aged 0–4 is rising.

takKiu7PPiPCe6RwvjHdRg.zh: 中國於國際期刊1/8發表報告顯示,於東北地區某醫院收集2023年5-7月間,對252名有蜱叮咬史並出現發熱症狀的患者進行檢體檢測,檢出由蜱傳播感染新型orthonairovirus病例,並將其命名為Xue-Cheng virus (XCV),於病例分布地區之蜱亦檢出XCV。
takKiu7PPiPCe6RwvjHdRg.en: A report published in an international journal on 8 January described samples collected at a hospital in the northeast region between May and July 2023 from 252 patients with a history of tick bites and fever. Testing detected cases of a novel tick-borne orthonairovirus infection, which the researchers named Xue-Cheng virus (XCV). XCV was also detected in ticks in the areas where the cases were located.

Bl76lfPiAxcPraBwmpTPYg.zh: 中國於1/9報告首起Ib型病例群聚疫情,指標病例為境外移入之外籍人員,具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,密切接觸者已有4例確診,相關病例以皮疹、皰疹等症狀為主,症狀輕微,均接受治療中。
Bl76lfPiAxcPraBwmpTPYg.en: On 9 January, China reported its first cluster of clade Ib cases. The index case was an imported case in a foreign national with a travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Four close contacts have since been confirmed. The cases mainly present with rash and blisters; symptoms are mild, and all are receiving treatment.

zdQGOdlKWUC5lUD9nzBScg.zh: 中國今年疫情嚴峻,幾乎全年居於嚴重呼吸道感染住院病例之病原首位,11月起陽性率已逐漸下降,影響全年齡層;日本今年下半年疫情亦嚴峻,自6月起疫情持續上升,至11月達高峰,峰為往年高峰近2倍,目前已逐週下降,惟仍處於極高水平。
zdQGOdlKWUC5lUD9nzBScg.en: China's severe respiratory infection situation in 2024 has been serious; Mycoplasma pneumoniae has been the leading pathogen among hospitalised severe respiratory infection cases for nearly the whole year. Positivity has gradually declined since November, affecting all age groups. Japan's epidemic was also severe in the second half of 2024: cases rose continuously from June and peaked in November at nearly twice the level of previous years' peaks. Cases are now falling each week but remain at an extremely high level.

1ihhweB36pdX5a7S-8iGOA.zh: 中國10月起疫情上升,近二週已成為門急診類流感病患之前三大病原,且升幅僅次於流感,主要影響14歲以下族群。
1ihhweB36pdX5a7S-8iGOA.en: Human metapneumovirus infections in China have risen since October. In the past two weeks, hMPV has become one of the top three pathogens among outpatient and emergency influenza-like illness cases, and its rate of increase is second only to influenza. It mainly affects people aged under 14.

oIKhRlCqu5JmBrxVmjPRlA.zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第48週(11/25-12/1)全球陽性率約13.4%,陽性率以歐洲區(14.4%)、美洲區(9.7%)及非洲區(8.1%)為高。 中國公布11月新冠感染疫情,新增35例重症及11例死亡,近期發燒門診就診量持平,類流感病例佔比略升,新冠陽性率處低點,以XDV及JN.1為主流變異株。 日本病例數連續4週上升,第50週(12/9-12/15)病例數逾20,000例,住院數亦持續增加,其中北海道及東北地區病例數快速增加;檢驗報告顯示以KP.3.1.1及KP.3.3為主流變異株,惟XEC變異株近期快速上升,佔比已達10%以上。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期略升,其中,非洲區及歐洲區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
oIKhRlCqu5JmBrxVmjPRlA.en: Epidemic update: In week 48 of 2024 (25 November–1 December), the global positivity rate was about 13.4%, highest in the European Region (14.4%), the Region of the Americas (9.7%) and the African Region (8.1%). China reported 35 new severe COVID-19 cases and 11 deaths in November. Recently, fever clinic visits have been flat and the proportion of influenza-like cases has risen slightly, while the COVID-19 positivity rate is at a low point; XDV and JN.1 are the main circulating variants. Japan's case numbers have risen for four consecutive weeks; in week 50 (9–15 December), over 20,000 cases were reported, hospitalisations also continued to rise, and the Hokkaido and Tohoku regions saw rapid increases. Test reports show that KP.3.1.1 and KP.3.3 are the main variants, but XEC has risen rapidly recently and now accounts for over 10%. Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has recently risen slightly, with slight increases in the African and European regions and flat or declining trends elsewhere. KP.3.1.1 is the main global circulating variant; the XEC share is rising, but severity has not yet increased. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and reliable testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

HgK3TLry5B0z1HbVFapQ_A.zh: 中國今年截至11/4,全國累計報告諾羅病毒腸胃炎疫情近300起,較去年同期減少36.7%,惟高於2019年同期,超過8成為校園通報,以中小學及幼教機構為主;GII.17為主要基因型,佔整體60%以上,當局表示需密切關注病毒變異情形。 英國英蘭地區於第47週至第48週(11/18-12/1) 諾羅病毒實驗室報告總數為過去5個流行季同期平均的2倍以上,自2024-2025流行季以來,醫院向通報系統報告疫情數量比過去5個流行季平均高出27.4%,經檢驗多數樣本基因型為GII.17,佔整體60%以上;蘇蘭地區第49週(截至12/8)累計報告1,718例,高於去年同期1,550例,亦高於2015-2019年同期平均1,208例。
HgK3TLry5B0z1HbVFapQ_A.en: China: As of 4 November this year, nationwide norovirus gastroenteritis outbreaks totalled nearly 300, 36.7% fewer than the same period last year but higher than the same period in 2019. Over 80% were reported from schools, mainly primary and secondary schools and early childhood education institutions. GII.17 is the main genotype, accounting for over 60% of cases, and authorities say the virus's variation needs close monitoring. United Kingdom: In England, norovirus laboratory reports for weeks 47 to 48 (18 November–1 December) were more than twice the average of the same period over the past five seasons. Since the 2024–2025 season began, the number of outbreaks reported by hospitals to the surveillance system has been 27.4% higher than the five-season average. Most samples tested were genotype GII.17, accounting for over 60% overall. In Scotland, 1,718 cases were reported cumulatively by week 49 (as of 8 December), higher than the 1,550 in the same period last year and the 2015–2019 same-period average of 1,208.

U2tpXFAnA9O6CCgUNObfzg.zh: 中國四川省11月報告2.6萬例病例,為10月份之3.4倍,整體而言南方流感活動度持平,北方10月起已逐漸上升;泰國整體流感疫情上升,高於去年同期,其中又以北部及東北地區升幅較明顯,當局呼籲民眾注意衛生並接種疫苗。
U2tpXFAnA9O6CCgUNObfzg.en: China: In November, Sichuan Province reported 26,000 cases, 3.4 times the number in October. Overall, influenza activity in southern China has been flat, while in northern China it has been rising since October. Thailand: Influenza activity has risen overall and is higher than the same period last year, with particularly marked increases in the northern and northeastern regions. Authorities urge the public to pay attention to hygiene and get vaccinated.

RPMpS9LgK0G_ZVwvsad2zA.zh: 香港公布中國新增2例人類感染H9N2病例,為貴州省及廣西壯族自治區1歲女童,分別於10/28及11/18發病,其餘資訊不明,該國今年累計9省市報告17例H9N2病例*。*9省17例為本署監測資訊,與CIDRAP統計不同。 美國12/10公布加州兒童病例(11/22報告)之基因定序結果,因病毒量不足,目前僅知該病毒屬2.3.4.4b分支,基因片段與加州流行之B3.13分支相,且無其他具威脅性之位點變異,亦與加拿大病例之病毒無關,評估對一般民眾風險仍然維持為低。
RPMpS9LgK0G_ZVwvsad2zA.en:
Hong Kong authorities reported two new human H9N2 infections in mainland China, in two 1-year-old girls from Guizhou Province and the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, with onset on 28 October and 18 November respectively. Other information is unavailable. China has reported 17 H9N2 cases from 9 provinces/municipalities this year.* *The 17 cases from 9 provinces are from Taiwan CDC surveillance information and differ from CIDRAP statistics.

On 10 December the United States released genetic sequencing results for a California child case (reported 22 November). Because the viral load was insufficient, it is currently only known that the virus belongs to clade 2.3.4.4b, that its gene segments are consistent with the B3.13 genotype circulating in California, and that there are no other threatening site mutations. It is also unrelated to the virus in the Canadian case. The risk assessment for the general public remains low.

6p-uy7JC3mA_JUGio5_8kw.zh: 美國加州佛雷斯諾郡11/27新增報告1例病例,為近30餘年來首例,病患10月中旬曾於美熹德郡經蝙蝠咬傷,並於11/22死亡,當局呼籲民眾避免接觸蝙蝠。 中國湖南省長沙縣11/18報告1例死亡病例,病患係經自養家犬咬傷感染,當局表示該省犬隻免疫接種率約30%,且抗體會隨時間下降,呼籲飼主確保寵物具足夠之抗體保護力。
6p-uy7JC3mA_JUGio5_8kw.en:
In Fresno County, California, a new case was reported on 27 November. It is the first case in more than 30 years. The patient had been bitten by a bat in Mariposa County in mid-October and died on 22 November. Authorities urge people to avoid contact with bats.

In Changsha County, Hunan Province, China, one death was reported on 18 November. The patient was infected through a bite from a dog raised at home. Authorities say the dog vaccination rate in the province is about 30%, and antibodies decline over time. They urge pet owners to ensure their pets have sufficient antibody protection.

3ScA83j9Qg_Q9G0pEMcwig.zh: 國際期刊11/7發表報告,於中國東北地區某醫院收集2022-2024年間病患檢體,檢出18例由蜱傳播感染Yezo病毒病例,以男性12例為多,病例之年齡中位數為53歲,Yezo病毒為2019年於日本北海道發現藉由蜱叮咬傳染的病毒。
3ScA83j9Qg_Q9G0pEMcwig.en: An international journal published a report on 7 November. Specimens from patients collected between 2022 and 2024 at a hospital in northeastern China were tested, and 18 cases of tick-borne Yezo virus infection were detected. Male patients accounted for most cases (12), and the median age of cases was 53 years. Yezo virus was first identified in Hokkaido, Japan, in 2019 as a virus transmitted through tick bites.

esDsWMdN2tET5o73jf1hQQ.zh: 香港11/12禽流感週報指出,中國新增報告7例H9N2人類感染病例,發病時間介於9/23至10/14,分布於湖南省4例、湖北/江西/四川省各1例,其中1例為67歲成年女性,餘為7歲以下兒童。
esDsWMdN2tET5o73jf1hQQ.en: Hong Kong's weekly avian influenza report dated 12 November states that China reported 7 new human H9N2 infections, with onset between 23 September and 14 October. Four were in Hunan Province, and one each in Hubei, Jiangxi and Sichuan provinces. One patient was a 67-year-old adult woman, and the rest were children under 7 years old.

cVRx4_LMcrb-nlc6EDNKeQ.zh: 中國多地諾羅病毒感染疫情進入高峰,廣東省諾羅病毒等腹瀉症狀疫情較去年同期為高,另學生症狀監視之腹瀉症狀報告率亦高於近3年同期,當局呼籲民眾注意手部及食品衛生。
cVRx4_LMcrb-nlc6EDNKeQ.en: Norovirus infections have reached their peak in many parts of China. In Guangdong Province, diarrhoeal outbreaks, including norovirus, are higher than in the same period last year. The reporting rate of diarrhoeal symptoms in student symptom surveillance is also higher than in the same period of the past three years. Authorities urge people to pay attention to hand and food hygiene.

hxShFTRyOIa0MVcdxiOOOQ.zh: 中國廣東省今年第43週(10/21-27)新增1,785例病例,9/9-10/27期間累計約1萬例病例,病例分布以佛山市及廣州市為多,今年迄今無死亡病例。
hxShFTRyOIa0MVcdxiOOOQ.en: Guangdong Province, China, reported 1,785 new cases in week 43 of this year (21–27 October). Between 9 September and 27 October, about 10,000 cases were cumulatively reported. Cases are mainly distributed in Foshan and Guangzhou. No deaths have been reported so far this year.

kiMhtVHLynYcg0TgKmzgvA.zh: 中國疫情持續,8、9月分別新增4.3萬及1.7萬餘例病例,相較4至7月期間,每個月通報7至9萬餘例已有和緩趨勢,惟仍遠高於往年平均數;今年截至9月已累計報告46萬9,712例,往年最高峰為2022年之3.6萬例。
kiMhtVHLynYcg0TgKmzgvA.en: Pertussis continues in China. Cases increased by 43,000 in August and by more than 17,000 in September.
